verdict.rationale: Mintlify's docs say it generates interactive API documentation from OpenAPI specs, with automatic endpoint pages and request builders. Its API-reference use-case page describes docs that are 'interactive for developers' and mentions an API playground, which the pricing page also lists as a platform feature. This covers exploring an interactive reference and running requests against endpoints. Missing for 10: detail on runnable example behavior (e.g., multi-language code samples, auth handling in the playground), independent or hands-on corroboration that the playground works as described.
